mapper.select:
WITH temp_table AS (
SELECT #{item.embryoCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} embryo_code, #{item.bomDataVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} bom_data_version FROM dual
)
where (embryo_code, bom_data_version) IN ( select embryo_code, bom_data_version from temp_table) and del_flag = '0' AND stock_month BETWEEN to_date(#{stockMonth,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM' ) AND last_day( to_date(#{stockMonth,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM' ) )
